name: How long does it take to see results after starting with AEO software?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results after starting with AEO software?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most businesses see initial AEO results within 3–6 months, but building consistent AI visibility often takes 6–12 months of structured content optimization. The timeline depends on your current topical authority, content freshness, and how quickly you implement schema markup and question-focused formatting.
acceptedAnswer.description: Initial results appear in 3–6 months; consistent AI visibility typically requires 6–12 months of content optimization, schema implementation, and authority building.
